verses.text: Ask the LORD for rain in the springtime. The LORD makes the storm clouds. He gives showers of rain to everyone, and plants in the fields for each person.

The household idols speak nonsense, and fortune-tellers see visions that are lies. They tell false dreams and give empty comfort. So the people wander like sheep. They suffer because there is no shepherd.
"My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Armies takes care of his flock, the people of Judah. He will make them like his proud war horse in battle.
From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the bow used in battle, and from him every ruler.
Together they will be like warriors trampling the enemy in the mud of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the enemy horsemen to shame.

"I will make the people of Judah strong, and I will save the people of Joseph. I will bring them back because I have mercy on them. It will be as if I had never rejected them, because I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them.
The people of Ephraim will become like warriors, and their hearts will be glad as if from wine. Their children will see it and be glad. Their hearts will celebrate in the LORD.
I will whistle for them and gather them in. I will surely set them free. They will be as many as before.
Though I scatter them among the nations, in distant lands they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will return.
I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be enough room for them.

They will pass through the sea of trouble. The waves of the sea will be calmed, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and Egypt will lose its power to rule.
I will make them strong in the LORD, and they will live by his name," says the LORD.
